content.tagline: Care for dehydrated skin — cactus, peptides and a simple layered routine
content.descriptor: BEAUTYBLVD, owner of Korean skincare brand DESERT FREE: one sunscreen and three Cactide serums
about: BEAUTYBLVD was founded on 1 November 2020. The company develops DESERT FREE, launched on 8 May 2024, around care for dry and dehydrated skin.

The Cactide range comprises Barrier Sun Cream, Double Repair Serum, Aquagel First Serum and Glow C Serum. The company profile names Kolmar Korea Co., Ltd. and Ancors Co., Ltd. as manufacturing partners; they are not presented as BEAUTYBLVD-owned factories.
facts: Kolmar Korea and Ancors named as manufacturing partners by the company

lines.name: Cactide Barrier Sun Cream
lines.note: 50 ml sunscreen, SPF 50+ PA++++. The official materials make no CPNP or MoCRA claim for this product.

lines.name: Cactide Double Repair Serum
lines.note: 50 ml serum with cactus, ectoin, peptide-12 and sugarcane-derived squalane, per BEAUTYBLVD.

lines.name: Cactide Aquagel First Serum
lines.note: 130 ml jelly-texture first serum-toner with cactus and collagen peptides, per the company.

lines.name: Cactide Glow C Serum
lines.note: 50 ml serum with vitamin C, Vita-Peptide and 2% niacinamide, per the company; the conflicting launch month is omitted.

tech.name: Cactide
tech.note: The name combines cactus + peptide; it is the brand ingredient concept, not a separate certification.

tech.name: Simple layered routine
tech.note: DESERT FREE structures the range around sunscreen, a first step and targeted serums.

content.exportNote: BEAUTYBLVD is open to B2B cooperation. Prices and commercial terms are not published and are requested through Teranova. The supplier states that the three serums are registered in EU CPNP and US MoCRA; supporting documents are checked at the deal stage.
